newsitem.title: USA: D&P upgrades Mattel rating to single-A.
newsitem.headline: D&P upgrades Mattel rating to single-A.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Wednesday it upgraded the long term debt rating of Mattel Inc to single-A from single-A-minus.
The commercial paper rating has also been raised to D-one from D-one-minus.
About $440 million of debt securities are affected by the rating action, D&P said in a statement.
D&P also assigned a preliminary rating of single-A to any senior debt issued under Mattel's outstanding $350 million shelf registration.

Mattel has consistently sustained a strong track record of improving operating cash flows, D&P said. The company has been successful in expanding its established brands including Barbie, Fisher-Price and Hot Wheels, it said.
